285425364.description:
Dunhill
Desktop Cigar Humidor - Polished Hardwood
Vintage Era, Brass Hardware & Humidifier Tubes
Crafted by British luxury house Alfred Dunhill, this vintage desktop cigar humidor showcases exceptional woodworking and specialized design. Engineered to maintain proper tobacco moisture, the box features perimeter ventilation vents, heavy brass stay hinges, and an interior side rack for humidification tubes. The interior lid displays an inlaid Dunhill plaque alongside a square brass bracket fixture.
Warm-toned polished wood exterior with fine visible grain
Interior compartment with slotted vents and removable divider
Two cylindrical humidification tubes with brass vented caps
Measures approximately 11" long by 9" high by 4.5" wide
Condition:
Very good vintage condition overall. Wood casing shows light surface marks and edge wear consistent with age. Brass hardware and hinges are firmly anchored and function smoothly. Key is not included. Humidifier tubes show interior residue from previous use.

284554663.description:
This listing features a natural 21K gold nugget weighing approximately 8.6 grams. The nugget contains visible quartz crystal inclusions encased within the gold. The piece is unmarked but has been tested and confirmed as 21K gold. It has an irregular, rough surface with a bright metallic gold color and off-white to gray quartz veins running through it. The nugget is unrefined and in its natural, unpolished state. Suitable for collectors, investors, or mineral specimen enthusiasts.
Please Note
Gemstones are tested using a Presidium Gem Tester. This tester cannot differentiate between manufactured and natural stones.
Gram weight includes materials and components of the entire item including stones unless noted.
Refer to photos for any additional markings that may be present.
High-end designer items are authenticated before listing.
Expect items to have normal wear from use. Items may require cleaning.
Jewelry pieces present in collection lots may have unspecified minor flaws.
Descriptions are made by individuals who may not have expertise specific to this type of item, in consultation with local and Internet resources. Shoppers are cautioned to evaluate items based upon their own resources. No guarantee of authenticity is implied unless specifically stated.
How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.
Collections
We are not able to answer questions about or provide condition descriptions for specific pieces present in collections of jewelry sold for jewelry making and crafting purposes, or in grab bags. Many pieces have unspecified condition issues. Please view provided photographs to determine general contents. No part of such groupings may be returned for any reason.
Condition descriptions for pieces present in scrap lots are not available and many pieces may have unspecified condition issues. Flaws may include missing stones, broken clasps, broken chains, bent or dented metal, repairs, and other damage. We are not able to answer questions about or provide condition descriptions for specific pieces present in scrap lots.
All items are sold as-is.

Their vibrant blue banding highlights natural crystalline formations, creating a visually captivating way to organize books or display as functional art. Also included is a stunning natural geode half, revealing an interior lined with sparkling quartz crystals for an organic, textured appearance that evokes the beauty of earth's treasures. Rounding out the bundle are five assorted rough mineral specimens in a mix of gray, brown, gold, and lilac shades with intriguing natural formations and visible crystal structuring. Each piece offers unique patterns, textures, and coloration. The set brings both decorative appeal and an authentic connection to the earth, ideal for desktops, shelves, or as conversation starters. All items are in good, used condition with some minor surface wear consistent with handling, making this a versatile and valuable assortment for collectors or those seeking distinctive natural home accents
